notes: 2026 rates and brackets are from the official 2026 Form IT-2105-I (New York State tax rates, page 10). The FY2026 budget cut the five lowest rates by 0.1 point for 2026 (e.g., 4% to 3.9%, 5.5% to 5.4%, 6% to 5.9%), with a further 0.1 point cut scheduled for 2027.

Supplemental tax / tax benefit recapture (approximated): above $107,650 of NY AGI the benefit of lower brackets is phased out over $50,000 so income is taxed at its bracket's flat rate; the exact IT-2105-I worksheets differ slightly in higher brackets. Above $25,000,000 all income is taxed at 10.9%.
No personal exemption for taxpayer or spouse; $1,000 per dependent exemption not modeled.

NY itemized deductions (with limitations above $100,000 NYAGI), NY subtractions (e.g., up to $20,000 pension/annuity exclusion) and credits (Empire State child credit, NY EITC, household credit, college tuition credit) are not modeled.

Metropolitan Commuter Transportation Mobility Tax (MCTMT) on self-employment earnings allocated to the MCTD (NYC plus Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk, Westchester): 0.60% in Zone 1 / 0.34% in Zone 2 of net earnings from self-employment if those earnings exceed $150,000 in the zone. Not modeled.

seDeduction.note: New York AGI starts from federal AGI, which already includes the deductible half of SE tax; no NY add-back.

seHealthInsurance.note: Inherited through federal AGI; no NY add-back.

retirementContributions.note: SEP/solo 401(k) deductions in federal AGI flow through to NY AGI.

qbi.note: The federal QBI deduction is taken after AGI and is not part of New York AGI.

localIncomeTax.note: New York City residents pay NYC resident income tax on NY taxable income at 3.078%-3.876% (2026 brackets: single 3.078% to $12,000, 3.762% to $25,000, 3.819% to $50,000, 3.876% above; MFJ thresholds $21,600/$45,000/$90,000; HOH $14,400/$30,000/$60,000). Self-employed individuals doing business in NYC also owe the 4% NYC Unincorporated Business Tax (UBT) if total gross business income exceeds $95,000 (credits reduce it for smaller amounts). Yonkers residents pay a surcharge of 16.75% of their net NYS tax. MCTMT also applies to SE earnings over $150,000 in the MCTD. None of these apply to the rest of the state, so none is modeled.

localities.name: New York City
localities.note: NYC resident income tax uses the 2025 rate schedule (unchanged in the 2026 withholding tables). UBT is 4% of net business income after the taxpayer allowance (20%, up to $10,000) and the $5,000 exemption, with the small-business credit and the resident credit on Form IT-219 (100% of UBT at NYC taxable income of $42,000 or less, falling to 23% at $142,000). UBT is not treated as a deductible expense here.

estimatedTax.threshold: Expected NYS, NYC or Yonkers tax of at least $300 after withholding and credits (any expected MCTMT also requires estimates)
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: No penalty if payments equal at least 90% of the 2026 tax, or 100% of the 2025 tax (110% if 2025 NY AGI - or net SE earnings allocated to the MCTD - exceeded $150,000; $75,000 if married filing separately), or 90% of annualized tax; 2025 return must cover 12 months. Farmers/fishers: 66 2/3%.

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $200 Articles of Organization (NY Department of State) plus the mandatory publication requirement: publish notice in two newspapers for six weeks within 120 days, then file a Certificate of Publication ($50). Newspaper costs vary widely (often several hundred dollars, more in NYC counties).
businessCosts.annualReportFee: $9 Biennial Statement every two years (NY Department of State).
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: A single-member LLC disregarded for federal tax purposes with New York-source income must pay a $25 annual filing fee on Form IT-204-LL. No other franchise tax for disregarded SMLLCs.
businessCosts.grossReceiptsTax: None statewide. NYC Unincorporated Business Tax (4% of net business income) applies if business gross income exceeds $95,000; not a gross receipts tax.
